headline: Executive order changes how the federal government runs its updated system of export controls.
what_it_does: This order deals with how federal agencies manage export controls, which are rules limiting what goods, technology, and information can be sent out of the United States. The title suggests it sets up how a reformed version of these rules will be carried out. No official summary was provided, so specific details are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that export controlled goods or technology
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how export rules are applied and which agencies handle them.
They may have roles or responsibilities assigned or adjusted under the reformed system.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 2013; the specific effective date is not stated in the provided material.
